Tube panpipes in 3D

How to use this view

Drag to turn, scroll or pinch to zoom; draw Explode to take it apart. Every part is the cut files’ own outline: each pipe a tube of finger-jointed strips, glued to its neighbours, with its plug, darker, at the blue line on its front. The buttons switch between the octagonal row, the hexagonal zigzag and the hexagonal row, each with the chamfer edge’s line along the back of the rim.
